metadata.title: UniversalPrintManagement
metadata.description: To report issues, please create a support request here: https://aka.ms/upsupport-azureportal. PowerShell module for managing Universal Print (in preview) from Microsoft. Universal Print is a modern print solution that organizations can use to manage their print infrastructure through cloud services from Microsoft Azure. Print administrators in an organization can register their printers with Universal Print to manage their properties, control access to them, and retrieve reports about their usage from one central location without any need for an on-premise print server.
